batchRequest.request: Add a second race for city council below the mayor's, with its own chart.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, kpis, shareCard, tableCard, precinctCard])
header = CardHeader("Mayoral Race — Election Night Results", "Updated 11:42 PM · 87% of precincts reporting")
kpis = OverviewCardBlock([k1, k2, k3])
k1 = OverviewCardItem("votes", k1top, k1bot)
k1top = IconText(Icon("vote", "general"), "neutral", "m", "Total Votes", "Counted so far", false, "horizontal")
k1bot = MetricIndicatorInline("184,320", "Turnout 46%", { direction: "up", value: 5 })
k2 = OverviewCardItem("reporting", k2top, k2bot)
k2top = IconText(Icon("map-pin", "maps"), "neutral", "m", "Precincts Reporting", "Of 200 total", false, "horizontal")
k2bot = MetricIndicatorInline("174 / 200", "87% reporting")
k3 = OverviewCardItem("margin", k3top, k3bot)
k3top = IconText(Icon("trending-up", "finance"), "neutral", "m", "Leading Margin", "Rivera over Chen", false, "horizontal")
k3bot = MetricIndicatorInline("6.4 pts", "Rivera leads", { direction: "up", value: 6 })
shareCard = Card([shareHeader, shareChart])
shareHeader = CardHeader("Vote Share", "Percent of votes counted")
shareChart = BarChart(names, [shareSeries], "grouped", "Candidate", "Vote share (%)")
names = ["Maria Rivera", "David Chen", "Aisha Okafor", "Tom Brennan", "Write-ins"]
shareSeries = Series("Vote share %", [41.2, 34.8, 15.6, 7.7, 0.7])
tableCard = Card([tableHeader, tbl])
tableHeader = CardHeader("Candidate Totals", "Party and votes counted")
tbl = Table([Col("Candidate", names), Col("Party", parties), Col("Votes", votes, "number"), Col("Share %", shares, "number")])
parties = ["Democratic", "Republican", "Independent", "Green", "—"]
votes = [75940, 64154, 28754, 14192, 1280]
shares = [41.2, 34.8, 15.6, 7.7, 0.7]
precinctCard = Card([precinctHeader, precinctBar, precinctLegend])
precinctHeader = CardHeader("Precincts Reporting", "174 of 200 precincts")
precinctBar = SingleStackedBarChart(["Reporting", "Outstanding"], [174, 26])
precinctLegend = Callout("info", "26 precincts outstanding", "Remaining precincts are mostly in the East District, where early results favored Rivera and Chen.")
request: Add a second race for city council below the mayor's, with its own chart.
